title: Understanding Block Replication
text: Each block of the file is stored on $$2$$ different machines. Think about how this replication affects the file's availability when machines fail.

title: Analyzing Machine Failures
text: Consider the scenario where $$3$$ out of $$4$$ machines fail. How many machines are left to potentially hold the blocks?

title: Probability of Block Availability
text: For a block to be available, at least one of its replicas must be on the remaining machine. What is the probability of this happening for a single block?

title: Calculating Overall Probability
text: If the probability of a single block being available is $$\frac{1}{2}$$, what is the probability that all $$8$$ blocks are available?
